name: Camp Seawood
operator_name: Girl Scouts of the Green and White Mountains
description_short: Girl Scout day camp on 38 acres of woods and wetlands in Portsmouth, with themed weekly programs by grade and a two week Counselor in Training course for older girls. Campers do crafts, archery and target sports, a low ropes course and nature hikes, 9:00 to 5:00.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 deposit, included in the session price, is not refundable.

sessions.name: Week of July 5 (grades K to 8 programs)
Week of July 12 (grades K to 8 programs)
Counselor in Training, two weeks (grades 9 to 10)

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; Summer 2027 sessions: two weeks, July 5 to 16; registration opens December 16 at 7 a.m.; program grades K to 10 as of the 2026/27 school year (the page also says campers who have completed K through grade 8); weekly program $375 where shown, CIT $600; non members must buy a Girl Scout membership; campership for council members; address 350 Banfield Rd, Portsmouth, NH 03801

warnings: Campers must be Girl Scouts; families who are not members buy a Girl Scout membership when registering (cost not on the page).
Only two weeks are posted for 2027 (July 5 to 16).
Grades are as of the 2026/27 school year, so ages are not derived. The July 12 week price is not in the page text.
Program Aide service hours ($200) are not listed as a session.
